brief.situation: You are a developer at Lumen Prints. Customers upload photos to gs://lumen-uploads-eu (europe-west1); an Eventarc trigger should send each object-finalized event to the Cloud Run service thumbnailer. The trigger was created yesterday by a script copied from another project, and since then no thumbnails have been made: 2,400 uploads are waiting. The holiday catalog email goes to 200,000 customers at 12:00 and links to their photo galleries.
handover: thumbnailer works when called by hand with a sample event.
The copied script created the trigger in us-central1, where the other project's bucket is.
howItWorks: The terminal shows each command's output; the diagram shows the upload bucket and its region, the Eventarc trigger and its location, and the thumbnail service.
Each command takes a minute or two; the clock moves only when you act or wait.
When you close, you write the record and explain your reasoning.

source.note: The catalog email goes out at 12:00, 110 minutes after the report, linking customers to galleries that need thumbnails.

writeup.question: For the record: why no events arrived, what you changed, and how it stays fixed.

parts.label: Why
parts.modelAnswer: The copied script created the trigger in us-central1; Cloud Storage events need the bucket in the trigger's region, and gs://lumen-uploads-eu is in europe-west1. Roles were already correct.

parts.label: Changed
parts.modelAnswer: Recreated the trigger in europe-west1 with the same filters and service account, deleted the old one and replayed 2,400 uploads; a test upload got its thumbnail. A public service opens it to everyone and still misses bulk uploads; redeploying changes nothing.

parts.label: Stays fixed
parts.modelAnswer: The deploy script takes the location from the bucket, and an alert fires when uploads outpace thumbnails.

scoring.modelReasoning: The service works and roles are fine, but the trigger is in us-central1 while the bucket is in europe-west1, and Eventarc needs the bucket in the trigger's region. Recreate the trigger in europe-west1 with the same filters and service account, delete the old one, replay the backlog and test a new upload. Making the service public opens it to everyone and misses bulk uploads; redeploying the service changes nothing. Then derive the location from the bucket in the deploy script.
